content.text: Assessing the item: a small 3-row table with four short parts. Part A is simple description of the data. Part B is a one-step percent change calculation, (17.6-7.7)/7.7 ≈ 128%. Part C requires comparing 2SE intervals: pH 7 spans 15.58-19.62 and pH 5 spans 12.48-15.92, so they overlap slightly (15.58-15.92), meaning the difference is not clearly statistically supported. This is a subtle step and the most demanding part. Part D connects pH to enzyme structure, with denaturation or changes in the active site's charge and shape. This is standard AP Biology 4.B/3.2 content, with low reading load and light arithmetic, and the item is fair and in scope.
